title: Flow Failure
fullDescription: FLO on Marquis Spas Gecko controllers indicates pressure switch did not close.

title: Internal Hardware Fault
fullDescription: HR indicates the controller detected internal hardware fault. Power cycle; replace if persistent.

title: Overheat Lockout
fullDescription: OH locks heater when water too hot.

title: Temperature Sensor A Fault
fullDescription: SnSa indicates temp sensor A open or shorted.

title: Hi-Limit Sensor Fault
fullDescription: SnSb indicates hi-limit sensor circuit fault.

title: Topside Communication Lost
fullDescription: COMM indicates topside lost link with control pack.
